title: Elections authorities ban dharnas, protests in Leh, Kargil ahead of polls

ai.summary: Elections authorities in Ladakh banned political protests and dharnas ahead of local polls to ensure free and fair elections, citing the Model Code of Conduct.

facts.claim: Elections authorities in Ladakh banned political protests and dharnas ahead of local polls to ensure free and fair elections
facts.quote: The Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) of Ladakh on Wednesday prohibited political dharnas, protests, rallies and similar collective activities that are likely “to impact the peaceful conduct of elections” within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil during the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) for the upcoming local polls, according to an official order.
